prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app
Primary request: Create concept-02 for page 31-X-09-notification-settings, state default. Reference state: no notification channel enabled, all notification conditions off, reminder controls disabled, preview and history empty. Make this concept control-state-first: disabled/off states should be obvious without looking messy.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS frame, device frame, or watermark. Preserve sidebar and settings notification active. Main: title, warning banner, two-column first row with channel selection card and conditions toggles card. Second row: reminder schedule card with disabled time input and weekday chips, plus preview card. Third: delivery history empty table/card and integration-prep info banner. Disabled save button at bottom.
Style/medium: polished Ant Design-compatible settings dashboard, compact, form-oriented, precise disabled states, no decorative layout.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian; Obsidian active nav/selected tab only; muted amber warning; muted blue-gray info; gray off toggles and disabled input.
Typography: Cosmica-like modern sans, Korean text as visual direction only, no negative letter spacing, readable form labels.
Must preserve state signals: no enabled channel warning, email/Zalo/both channel tabs, off notification toggles, disabled reminder time/day, preview empty, send history empty, disabled save.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, colorful notification palette, gradients, decorative bell art, colorful CTA, heavy shadows, giant cards.
